full_prompt_en: A square cinematic fantasy landscape shows a solitary traveler on a snow-covered shore beneath immense cliffs, with a distant stone tower rising from a rocky promontory. The left side of the scene is dominated by a steep blue-gray mountain wall, its shadowed rock faces and snow patches descending toward the foreground. A pale sunlit strip of snow curves from the lower left around the waterline toward the middle distance. The traveler stands small near this curve, cloaked in dark clothing and facing the distant water and architecture. On the right, calm blue-gray water fills a broad inlet, with a small sailboat resting near the shore under thin rigging. Beyond it, the tall narrow tower and attached masonry structures rise on a dark isolated rock, their pale walls catching light against hazy mountain ridges. The sky is clear muted blue with soft cream clouds gathered near the peaks and behind the tower. Tiny birds or distant specks cross the open upper right. Near the foreground, scattered stones and low dark forms interrupt the snow, giving it rough physical texture. The image has finely rendered rock and building detail but softens rapidly in the far mountains and sky, establishing great depth. Cool daylight enters from above and right, brightening the snowy slope and tower while the near cliffs remain in blue shadow. The water reflects subdued sky color without strong mirror images. No legible text appears. The overall composition leads from the small dark figure along the bright shoreline toward the remote tower, creating a spacious, contemplative journey through cold stone and light.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形电影感奇幻风景描绘一名孤身旅人立于巨崖下的雪岸，远处石塔从岩石岬角上升起。场景左侧被陡峭蓝灰色山壁主导，阴影岩面与积雪片向前景下降。一条受光的浅色雪带从左下沿水线弯向中景。旅人身形很小，站在弯曲雪线附近，披深色衣物，面向远水和建筑。右侧，平静蓝灰水面填满宽阔海湾，一艘小帆船在岸边停着，细索具立在船上。更远处，高而窄的塔楼和相连石建筑立在深色孤岩上，浅色墙面在朦胧山脊前接住亮光。天空是清澈柔和的蓝，柔软奶油色云聚在峰顶附近和塔后。小鸟或远方细点穿过开阔的右上方。前景处，散落石块和低矮暗形打断积雪，赋予其粗糙实体肌理。岩石与建筑细节描绘精密，但远山和天空迅速柔化，建立巨大的纵深。冷日光从上方偏右进入，照亮雪坡与塔楼，近处山崖仍在蓝影中。水面反映柔和天空色，没有强烈镜像倒影。没有可读文字。整体构图从小小暗色人物沿明亮岸线引向遥远塔楼，在冷石与光中构成宽阔沉思的旅程。
style_prompt_en: Cinematic fantasy landscape sets finely textured stone and near-ground detail against expansive, softly hazed distance. Blue-gray, ice white, muted teal, and pale cream dominate, with dark silhouettes used sparingly to establish scale. A bright curving plane carries the eye from close shadow toward an isolated distant focal shape. Cool daylight strikes exposed surfaces while steep faces remain in saturated blue shadow. Edges sharpen in the near rocks and architecture, then dissolve through misty mountain layers. The overall effect is vast, quiet, and physically grounded.
style_prompt_zh: 电影感奇幻风景把精细纹理的石面与近地细节放在宽阔柔雾远景前。蓝灰、冰白、柔和蓝绿和浅奶油色占主导，深色剪影只少量使用以建立尺度。明亮的弯曲平面把视线从近处阴影带向孤立的远方焦点形状。冷日光照到外露表面，陡面仍留在饱和蓝影中。近处岩石与结构边缘较锐，随后通过雾蒙蒙的山层逐渐消散。整体辽阔、安静而有实体感。
theme_en: A solitary traveler on a snowy shore below a distant stone tower
theme_zh: 一名孤身旅人立在雪岸上，远处岩头有石塔
name: Raphael Lacoste
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
